projectSummary: Mock fixture for RepoMap development. This is a small demo service used to exercise the Onboarding Map UI without calling IBM Bob 2.0: a tiny HTTP API with one web tier, one domain module and one shared module.

modules.name: web
modules.purpose: Starts the HTTP server, wires routes and renders the demo HTML page.

modules.name: core
modules.purpose: Holds the domain logic: the catalogue, pricing rules and validation.

modules.name: shared
modules.purpose: Shared helpers and error types used by every other module.

modules.name: tests
modules.purpose: Integration and unit tests; the only place that exercises the whole request path.

recommendedFiles.reason: Explains how to install and run the demo service.
Entry point of the service and the first file to read.
The domain model everything else is built around.

gotchas: The demo service reads PORT from the environment and defaults to 3000, which collides with the RepoMap frontend during the demo.
tests/api.test.ts starts a real server on a fixed port, so it fails if another instance is already running.
src/shared/logger.ts writes to stdout in plain text, so log parsing in the demo needs a prefix filter.
